api_endpoint.label: API Endpoint
api_endpoint.description: Base URL for the API (default Ollama uses http://localhost:11434/v1)

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: API key for hosted providers (stored locally and never shared)

mode.label: Thinking Mode
mode.description: How deeply the AI thinks before responding

tool_permission.label: Tool Permission
tool_permission.description: When the AI can run terminal commands

web_search_enabled.label: Web Search
web_search_enabled.description: Allow Mimir to use DuckDuckGo search and fetch public pages

show_commands.label: Show Commands
show_commands.description: Show executed commands in the chat

max_history.label: Max History
max_history.description: Number of messages to keep in conversation context
